name: ma_crossover_momentum_5s
author: adapted from aggregated_from_x_indian_traders
thesis: Exploiting short-term momentum from 9/21 EMA crossover with volume in trending sessions. Inefficiency from lag in retail response to cross. Survives due to index filter and VIX cap preventing whipsaws.
mechanism: Moving average crossovers detect shifts in the balance between recent and historical average prices. A bullish crossover indicates that recent institutional buying has pushed the short-term average above the long-term, reflecting a change in the dominant order flow direction. The new trend persists as algorithms and discretionary traders align with the crossover signal.
weaknesses: Regime dependency: choppy markets cause whipsaws
Slippage on fast moves during cross
Crowding: MA crossover taught everywhere on X
prior_art: MA Crossover (listed in StockX India X thread)
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; apply to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index instead of FnO universe; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
